implementation: Preconnect the site's original Socket.IO client during disbandment countdown; hold only start_game_search until a proven on_stop_game and player readiness. Send the site's original payload directly, await ACK, then navigate the same tab to the standard search page and restore via the site's client without a DOM click.

siteEvidence.recovery: checkIfUserInSearch calls /api/search/me; disconnected search starts a new connection. session_initialized with own timeInSearch restores state without another start_game_search. This demonstrates the intended client recovery path, not a live proof of unchanged server priority.
